guidance.paragraph1: cyThe tribunal will usually make its decision based on the documents and evidence provided by you and the landlord.
guidance.paragraph2: cyOnly ask for a hearing if you want to attend a tribunal to add to the documents and evidence you have provided. The tribunal will consider all documents and evidence with or without a hearing.
guidance.paragraph3: cyThe tribunal will decide if a hearing is needed.

reasonHearingRequested.label: cyTell us why you think a hearing is needed

hearingRequested.required: cySelect yes if you want a hearing

reasonHearingRequested.required: cyEnter why you think a hearing is needed
reasonHearingRequested.invalid: cyWhy you think a hearing is needed must be 500 characters or fewer
